messages:
lina: Quick catch — when you save a per-route view that has a pinned model + quota preview enabled, the Console sometimes shows stale quota numbers after a rollout. Noticed this on route `/api/generate`

sam: repro steps? I tried saving a view earlier and saw something similar but assumed caching.

lina: steps: 1) Select route `/api/generate` -> Filters: model=redwood-v1-small (pinned) + latency<200ms 2) Toggle quota preview (show estimate) 3) Save as 'pv-pinned-with-quota' 4) After canary rollout of redwood-v1-small->redwood-v1-medium, open saved view. quota panel shows old token estimate.

kevin: hmm. Is the saved-view payload storing model pin by id or by name? If it stores name and rollout swaps to a model id, mismatch could cause stale lookup.

lina: payload stores model_ref: { "type": "pin", "value": "redwood-v1-small" } and saves a preview snapshot at save-time. UI fetches live quota but falls back to snapshot if the live fetch returns 404 quickly.

maria: that fallback logic was added to avoid flicker during outages — maybe too aggressive. Should we change fallback to accept only >1s timeouts rather than immediate?

ux_research: UX concern: users expect saved views to reflect current capacity & pricing unless they explicitly ask for a snapshot. We should make a clear affordance: "Use snapshot" vs "Live estimates". Default to Live.

sam: agree. From infra side, the live estimate endpoint can be a bit noisy during rollouts. We could return a best-effort estimate with a confidence flag instead of 404 fallback. UI can show a warning: "estimate low confidence".

kevin: technical proposal: change saved view schema to include model_pin as canonical id + optional snapshot {quota_estimate, token_cost, timestamp}. On load: 1) try live_estimate(model_id) with 800ms timeout 2) if response ok show it + confidence 3) else use snapshot but surface banner \"This view is using a saved snapshot from <ts>.\"

lina: +1. Also need telemetry events: saved_view_load -> {used_snapshot: true/false, confidence: high/low, live_latency_ms}. We want to track how often fallback happens during rollouts.

maria: rollout UX tie-in: when a model variant changes we should invalidate snapshots for views that pinned by name but not by canonical id, or at least surface a mismatch. Might need backend job to reconcile.

ux_research: small UX copy: banner text suggestion: \"Showing saved snapshot (saved on 2025-06-01). Toggle to live estimates\" — with a quick toggle in top-right of the panel.

kevin: backend tasks: (a) extend saved_views table with snapshot JSON and model_canonical_id column, (b) live_estimate endpoint add confidence flag + p95 latency metric in response, (c) migrate existing saved views to populate snapshot where missing.

sam: ops-bot: rolling this change will touch many read paths. ops-bot any concerns?

ops-bot: deployment note: plan a canary for 48 hours on ~10% of traffic, monitor perf.live_estimate.latency_p95 and savedview.fallback_rate. Auto-rollback threshold: fallback_rate > 2% for 10m or p95 > 1200ms.

lina: I'll draft a short RFC with the schema change + UX mock for the toggle. Can I get volunteers for review?

maria: I'll take the UX copy + mock.

kevin: I'll own the backend schema + migration plan.

sam: I'll add the live_estimate confidence flag and the telemetry hooks.

lina: thanks — pinging in #eng-oncall when we have the canary plan. :thumbsup:

kevin: one more note — remember saved filters that include cross-route aggregations (per-model breakdown) also rely on route->model routing policies. If routing policy changes during rollout, estimates will diverge. We'll include a routing_policy_version in the snapshot to aid debugging.

lina: good call. Adding that to the RFC checklist.

sam: okay landing: RFC + small patch to UI to default to Live and add toggle. We'll iterate after telemetry.

maria: moving to Figma now for the toggle, will share link soon.

lina: thanks everyone.
